source.author: verg
source.text: Ardet abire fuga dulcisque relinquere terras, attonitus tanto monitu imperioque deorum.
source.text_original: Ardet abire fuga dulcisque relinquere terras, / attonitus tanto monitu imperioque deorum.
source.text_english: He burns to depart in flight and to leave the sweet lands behind, thunderstruck by so great an admonition and command of the gods.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: At ducis imperiis Minyae monituque frequentes puppem umeris subeunt et tento poplite proni decurrunt intrantque fretum.
reuse.text_original: At ducis imperiis Minyae monituque frequentes / puppem umeris subeunt et tento poplite proni / decurrunt intrantque fretum.
reuse.text_english: But at the commander’s orders and under his urging, the many Minyae take up the ship on their shoulders and, with bent knees, run downhill and enter the strait.
